# Accept header vectors for the Markdown-versus-HTML choice.
#
# The same file is checked in, byte for byte, in We-Amp/mod_pagespeed
# (test/net/instaweb/rewriter/testdata/accept_markdown_vectors.txt) and in
# We-Amp/pagespeed-optimizer (test/lib/classify/testdata/accept_markdown_vectors.txt).
# Both test suites assert every line and pin the file's FNV-1a 64-bit hash
# (computed with carriage returns removed). Change the two copies together and
# update the pin in both tests.
#
# Format: <id> <verdict> [<line>]...
#   verdict MD   = the Markdown copy is selected
#   verdict HTML = HTML is served
#   each <...> is one Accept header line, verbatim between the brackets;
#   several lines are combined in order as one comma-separated list
#   (RFC 9110 section 5.3); no <...> at all means the header is absent.
#
# Rule: Markdown is selected only when text/markdown is named explicitly, its
# q is above 0, and its q is at least the q text/html resolves to (most
# specific of text/html, text/*, */*, else 0). Wildcards never select
# Markdown. Equal q selects Markdown, whatever the order. A malformed header
# (q outside [0, 1], more than three decimals, unparseable, or text/markdown
# listed twice with different q) selects HTML.
#
# Vectors 36 to 42 are Accept headers real clients send: 36 Claude Code,
# 37 Cursor, 38 OpenCode, 39 an MCP fetch server, 42 a browser-style header
# (as sent by Codex and ChatGPT-User).
1 MD <text/markdown>
2 HTML <text/markdown;q=0>
3 HTML <text/markdown;q=0, text/html>
4 MD <text/markdown, text/html>
5 MD <text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9>
6 HTML <text/markdown;q=0.5, text/html>
7 MD <text/html;q=0.5, text/markdown;q=0.8>
8 HTML <*/*>
9 HTML <text/markdown;q=0, */*>
10 HTML <text/*>
11 HTML <text/*;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.1>
12 MD <text/markdown;q=0.6, text/*;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.5>
13 HTML <text/markdown;q=0.4, */*;q=0.5>
14 MD <text/markdown;charset=utf-8, text/html;q=0.5>
15 MD <text/markdown;variant=GFM;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.8>
16 MD <TEXT/Markdown, text/html;q=0.5>
17 MD <text/markdown;Q=0.9, text/html;q=0.5>
18 HTML <text/markdown;q=0.9999, text/html;q=0.5>
19 HTML <text/markdown;q=1.5>
20 HTML <text/markdown;q=-0.1>
21 HTML <text/markdown;q=abc, text/html;q=0.1>
22 HTML <text/markdown;q=0.9, text/markdown;q=0.1, text/html;q=0.5>
23 MD <text/markdown, text/markdown, text/html;q=0.5>
24 MD <text/html;q=0.5> <text/markdown>
25 MD <text/markdown> <text/html>
26 HTML <text/markdown> <text/markdown;q=0>
27 HTML
28 HTML <>
29 HTML <text/markdown;;q=>
30 MD <text/markdown;q=0.001, text/html;q=0>
31 HTML <text/markdown;q=0.000, text/html;q=0>
32 MD <application/json, text/markdown;q=0.5>
33 MD < text/markdown ; q=0.8 , text/html;q=0.5>
34 HTML <text/markdownx, text/html;q=0.5>
35 MD <text/markdown;q=1.0, text/html;q=1>
36 MD <text/markdown, text/html, */*>
37 MD <text/markdown,text/html;q=0.9,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.8,application/xml;q=0.7,image/webp;q=0.6,*/*;q=0.5>
38 MD <text/markdown;q=1.0, text/x-markdown;q=0.9, text/plain;q=0.8, text/html;q=0.7, */*;q=0.1>
39 MD <text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9, */*;q=0.8>
40 MD <text/markdown, */*>
41 MD <text/html, text/markdown>
42 HTML <text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7>
